foundation: Each segment (a through g) of a 7-segment LED display is driven by Boolean expressions combining NOT (7404), 2-input AND (7408), 3-input AND (7411), and OR (7432) gates.
optimization: In Stage 2, NAND-NAND logic replaces AND-OR logic directly using IC 7400.
industrial: In Stage 3, NOR-NOR logic replaces OR-AND logic directly using IC 7402.
